read.thesis: Record markets and IB quarter with equities up 86%, but management flagged pull-forward and said the equity spike is hard to repeat; FY NII ex-Markets raised to $96.5B and expense to $107.5B.

triggers.label: Equities revenue up 86% YoY
triggers.quote: The equities business delivered an exceptionally strong quarter, with revenue up 86% year-on-year

triggers.label: NII ex-Markets raised to $96.5B
triggers.quote: we now expect NII ex-Markets to be about $96.5 billion

triggers.label: Pull-forward in IB and equities
triggers.quote: I think clearly there was some pull forward, and clearly the large deals contributed meaningfully to this quarter of results.

triggers.label: Peers loosening underwriting
triggers.quote: Some weaker covenants, some people taking more rollover risk.

guidance.quote: we now expect NII ex-Markets to be about $96.5 billion
total NII to be approximately $105.5 billion
markets NII increasing to about $9 billion
The new adjusted expense outlook is about $107.5 billion
we now expect card net charge-off rate to be approximately 3.2%

red_flags.label: Underwriting standards softening at peers
red_flags.quote: Some weaker covenants, some people taking more rollover risk.

red_flags.label: Negative convexity in deposits
red_flags.quote: Obviously that wouldn't be true if you had to do a massive repurchase of the deposit franchise in order to protect it

evasions.quote: Several years, you can use a few years, you can use plus or minus, or obviously, it's totally up to the board, not up to me.
We're not going to have false gods.
